states.label: Closed
states.sublabel: refused if it holds a balance

transitions.label: POST /{id}/close
transitions.note: Refused 422 GROUP_HOLDS_BALANCE if any account it holds carries a non-zero balance or held amount

cards.title: Delete is not on this diagram
items: DELETE removes the row entirely — refused (GROUP_NOT_EMPTY) while the group holds any account, regardless of status
It is not a status transition, since the row stops existing

cards.title: Why Close stays hand-written
items: The refusal reads Account, a different aggregate, so a generated [CrudAction] handler can't express it
